name: Notubiz Vote to decidesk Vote
description: Maps an individual Notubiz vote record onto decidesk's Vote schema. Notubiz vote value voor/tegen/onthouding (or for/against/abstain) maps to value for/against/abstain. weight defaults to 1. castAt comes from the vote date, falling back to the parent decision date.

mapping.value: {% set v = (values.value ?? values.vote ?? values.stem ?? '')|lower %}{% if v == 'voor' or v == 'for' %}for{% elseif v == 'tegen' or v == 'against' %}against{% elseif v == 'onthouding' or v == 'abstain' or v == 'blanco' %}abstain{% else %}{% endif %}
